description: Set one or more environment variables for an app or a specific service. Existing keys are overwritten; other keys are preserved. Affected services are redeployed automatically.

secrets.description: Key/value pairs. Keys must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores.

service.description: Scope secrets to a single service. Omit for app-wide secrets.

name: runzero_set_secrets
title: Set secrets
